newsitem.title: KUWAIT: Kuwait's Mazeedi wants OPEC quota compliance.
newsitem.headline: Kuwait's Mazeedi wants OPEC quota compliance.

text.p: Kuwait's Oil Minister Isa al-Mazeedi said in remarks published on Tuesday that it was important for fellow OPEC member countries to comply with oil production quotas to maintain stable oil prices.
"It is important that the organisation's (OPEC) countries comply with the production ceiling and designated quotas," Mazeedi told al-Rai al-Aam newspaper.
"Experience has proved that constant quota complinace would ...maintain the stability of (oil) prices."
Asked if Kuwait would present "any requests" during OPEC's ministerial meeting to be held on Wednesday in Vienna, Mazeedi said: "Kuwait always tries to contribute to the stability of the oil market."

Kuwait, which has a production quota of two million barrels per day (bpd), has often said it would seek a larger quota when OPEC decides to increase its self-imposed output ceiling set at 25.03 million bpd.
Kuwait puts its production capacity at 2.5 million bpd.
